result.title: Music–color associations are mediated by emotion
key_claims: Mainarticle/all3experiments/equations read2026-09-22; supplement could not be retrieved and is NOT claimedread.18classical excerpts,37colors,US/Mexico samples. Fulltext https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3670360/.

Relative associations connect faster/major music to lighter/more saturated/yellower choices versus slower/minor darker/desaturated/bluer choices. This is not a unique hue per song, time-varyingstage cue supervision, or a universal red=arousal rule.

Stimulus-level correlations are not heldout prediction or causalmediation proof; authors explicitly acknowledge correlation/direction limits. Motivates stochastic palette/style choices and separate hue/chroma/brightness evaluation, not mandatoryemotionfeatures.
